subject: Kickoff: city relighting track (May-Aug)
body:
Team — kicking off the city relighting track.

The research decomposes stacks of street panoramas into intrinsic components — log reflectance and log shading — and can relight the same scene under new illumination. Product-wise that's the missing piece for consistent map imagery across capture times.

Plan: (1) repro the pretrained checkpoint on the NYC sample stack by May 15 — note the code pins Python 3.7-era deps, so environments are their own task; (2) alignment pipeline for our own capture stacks by end of June — the release runs twenty gradient-descent steps with frozen weights per new stack; (3) internal relighting demo mid-July; (4) launch review before Aug 3.

Daniela follows up on staffing. Carmen owns decomposition quality, Wanjiru and Oyin the pipeline, Chiara env/tooling, Bilal the eval harness.

Dmitri
